<reason>Side A won by demonstrating that semi-automation relocates rather than eliminates judgment into unaccountable calibration, and by exposing Side B's "inconclusive default" as a buried choice about margins and purpose, while showing the "physical plausibility" override test fails to catch plausible tracking errors.
